formula: eta_TiPt ~= DeltaQ_mhat*S_E^q*b_mhat + DeltaQ_e*S_E^q*b_alpha + direct_delta_w_block + direct_delta_w_shadow + projector_tail_abs
If b_mhat=0, delta_w_block=0, delta_w_shadow=0, projector_tail=0 and S_E^q is known, MICROSCOPE gives |S_E^q*b_alpha| <= eta_bound/DeltaQ_e.
If b_alpha=0 and all direct source/shadow/projector tails vanish, MICROSCOPE gives |S_E^q*b_mhat| <= eta_bound/DeltaQ_mhat.
